title: Jailbreak Evaluator Disagreement Benchmark: Measuring Inter-Judge Inconsistency as a First-Class Metric

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identified by the 2026 survey as 'perhaps the most concerning finding.' If evaluators disagree, all published results are evaluator-artifacts. Foundational infrastructure for trustworthy safety science. Compelling impact chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running responses through multiple publicly available evaluators is well-documented. Computing inter-rater agreement (Cohen's Kappa, Krippendorff's alpha) is standard statistics. The main work is data collection, which is mechanical.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 200-500 responses x 4-6 evaluators is a large matrix. Assembling the dataset, running all evaluators, and creating disagreement heatmaps is substantial. The scope is conceptually clear but operationally heavy. May need to limit to 200 responses and 4 evaluators to fit 30 hours.
